name: MiniMax H3 [ref2va]
note: [MiniMax H3 [ref2va]](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3) generates video guided by reference subjects, objects, or scenes. Provide reference images through the canvas and moodboard, and identify them in the prompt as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, etc. The CFG-distilled base model generates 24 FPS video with synchronized 32 kHz stereo audio. Start with a 768-pixel short side, 50 DDIM Trailing steps, Text Guidance 1, Shift 12, and Audio Shift 3.
